cases.title: Each band produces exactly its stated effect

steps.action: an account whose margin level is 160%
a cycle runs
no email is sent and no restriction is applied
the level falls to 130%
the account is visible to operators in Warning, is not restricted and is not emailed
the level falls to 110%
the customer is emailed and withdrawals, transfers and new buys are frozen, and nothing is sold
the level falls to 95%
part of the largest position is sold and selling stops once the level reaches 105%

cases.title: Sells the biggest position, one per cycle, only to 105%

steps.action: Hold three marginable positions worth 5,000, 3,000 and 1,000 in the account currency and drive the level to 90%.
steps.expectedResult: The first cycle places one sell order, on the 5,000 position, for the quantity that brings the level to 105% and no more.

steps.action: Observe the next cycle after the sale fills.
steps.expectedResult: The level is re-measured before any further sale; at or above 105% nothing else is sold.

cases.title: Refuses to sell into a closed market or on stale data, and resumes later

steps.action: Drive an account below 100% while its instrument's exchange is closed.
steps.expectedResult: No sell order; the account stays flagged.

steps.action: Open the market with prices more than a few hours stale.
steps.expectedResult: Still no sell order; the position is treated as un-sellable.

steps.action: Refresh prices and rates.
steps.expectedResult: Selling resumes on the next cycle.

cases.title: An account with no maintenance requirement shows a blank margin level and is never liquidated

steps.action: Fund a margin-enabled account and hold only instruments that are not marginable.
steps.expectedResult: The margin level reads blank on every screen and export, never 0%.

steps.action: Run several cycles.
steps.expectedResult: No band change, no margin call, no sale.

cases.title: Broken band configuration is refused with the consequence stated

steps.action: As an operator, delete the auto-liquidation band.
steps.expectedResult: Refused; the message says selling could never trigger.

steps.action: Delete the warning band.
steps.expectedResult: Refused; the message says customers would not be warned.

steps.action: Set the cushion so liquidation would end above the margin-call threshold.
steps.expectedResult: Refused; the message names the threshold it would cross.

steps.action: Make a valid change.
steps.expectedResult: Applied on the next cycle without a restart.
